name: purplebee
description: Plan trips, picnics, potlucks, dinners and parties with friends: who's coming, who brings what, shared to-dos, invites and splitting expenses.

interface.shortDescription: Who brings what, who owes what
interface.longDescription:
PurpleBee brings everyone together: plan trips, camping weekends, holidays, picnics, barbecues, potlucks, dinners, birthdays and office breakfasts with your group.

Just describe your plan to ChatGPT, for example "a picnic for 8 next Saturday where everyone brings something", and it builds a real shared event in PurpleBee:
• The event with date, the real place on the map, a cover photo and a music list
• What to bring with realistic quantities, plus what everyone brings for themselves
• Open to-dos like booking the place or arranging transport
• A ready invite message to send to your group on WhatsApp

Friends open the link, join and pick what they'll bring. Later, ask ChatGPT:
• "I'll bring the drinks" to claim an item
• "I paid 1,200 for the villa, split it with everyone" to add a shared expense
• "Who owes whom after our holiday?" for balances and the simplest way to settle up
• "Is Saturday free?" to check clashes with your other plans

Ask for restaurant, café or sight ideas and ChatGPT adds the ones you pick to the event's Places & Routes list, or builds a route with its stops.

Only need photos and music? ChatGPT can turn off the items, tasks or expenses sections your group won't use, but only after asking you.

ChatGPT asks about what's missing instead of guessing (date, place, number of people, your music taste) and only adds what you agree to.

Everything appears instantly in the PurpleBee app for the whole group. In the app your group also gets a shared photo album, a shared music list, group chat, join requests the organizer approves, repeating events, photo proof for items and expenses when the organizer asks for it, and a rating after the event. Phone numbers stay private between attendees. ChatGPT acts as you and only reaches events you can see. It can create and edit, but it can never delete anything. PurpleBee only tracks who owes whom; it never moves money.

New to PurpleBee? Sign in with your email at purplebee.app.
defaultPrompt: Plan a picnic for 8 next Saturday where everyone brings something
Organize a camping weekend for 6 friends and make the packing list
Who owes whom after our trip?

positive.description: Indirect request without naming the app
positive.prompt: I'm organizing a barbecue for 10 friends next Sunday and everyone should bring something. Can you set it up?
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event, asks about the place and anything missing, adds a shared list of things to bring with quantities for about 10 people, and gives the invite message once the date and place are set.

positive.prompt: Create a PurpleBee event called 'Bozcaada camp' on 24-25 October in Bozcaada.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event and replies with its link and invite link.

positive.description: Add items and a to-do to an existing event
positive.prompt: In my 'Weekend camp' event add 12 liters of water and charcoal, everyone brings their own sleeping bag, and add a task 'Book the campsite'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the event and adds two shared items, one personal item and one task.

positive.prompt: In 'Weekend camp' I paid 600 TRY for groceries, split it with Deniz.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 600 TRY expense paid by the user, split equally between the user and Deniz.

positive.prompt: Pick a cover photo for 'Weekend camp' and add two acoustic campfire songs to its music list.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a few Unsplash photos, sets the one the user picks as the cover with the photographer credit, and adds two YouTube songs to the event's music list.

positive.description: Free day check and real place
positive.prompt: Is Saturday 7 November free for me? If so, plan a picnic in Belgrad Forest, Istanbul for 8 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports any clashing events, then creates the event with the real place and its map point, 8 expected guests, and returns the invite message and what is still missing.

positive.description: Turn off sections the group won't use, after asking
positive.prompt: Create a PurpleBee event 'Concert night' for this Friday at Zorlu PSM. We only want to share photos and music, we don't need items, tasks or expenses.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event, confirms which sections to turn off, then turns off items, tasks and expenses (sections: ['places'] or []) and explains they can be turned back on any time without losing anything.

positive.description: Suggest places and add the picked ones
positive.prompt: Create a PurpleBee event 'Bozcaada day trip' for next Saturday in Bozcaada, then suggest 3 cafés near Bozcaada harbour and add the ones I pick.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event, searches real cafés, shows a few with addresses, and adds only the cafés the user picks to the event's Places & Routes list.

negative.prompt: Delete my 'Weekend camp' event in PurpleBee.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use PurpleBee
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Bozcaada this weekend?

negative.description: Cannot add an expense for someone who is not in the event
negative.prompt: In 'Weekend camp', Mehmet paid 300 TRY for fuel.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3: ChatGPT can suggest restaurants, cafés and sights and add the ones you pick to the event's new Places & Routes list, or build a route with its stops. It can also turn off sections an event doesn't need (for example when the group only shares photos and music), always after asking you first.

tr-TR.subtitle: Kim ne getirir, kim ne öder
tr-TR.description:
PurpleBee herkesi bir araya getirir: kamp, tatil, piknik, mangal, doğum günü, akşam yemeği ve ofis kahvaltısı gibi her buluşmayı grubunla planla.

Planını ChatGPT'ye anlatman yeterli, örneğin "cumartesi 8 kişilik piknik, herkes bir şey getirsin". ChatGPT PurpleBee'de gerçek, ortak bir etkinlik oluşturur:
• Tarih, haritada gerçek yer, kapak fotoğrafı ve müzik listesi
• Gerçekçi miktarlarla getirilecekler ve herkesin kendi getireceği şeyler
• Yer ayırtmak, ulaşımı ayarlamak gibi açık görevler
• WhatsApp grubuna gönderebileceğin hazır davet mesajı

Arkadaşların linki açıp katılır ve ne getireceğini seçer. Sonra ChatGPT'ye:
• "İçecekleri ben getiririm" de, üstlensin
• "Villaya 1.200 ödedim, herkesle böl" de, masrafı eklesin
• "Tatilden sonra kim kime borçlu?" de, en kolay ödeşmeyi göstersin
• "Cumartesi boş muyum?" de, diğer planlarınla çakışmayı kontrol etsin

Restoran, kafe ya da gezilecek yer önerisi iste; ChatGPT seçtiklerini etkinliğin Mekanlar & Rotalar listesine ekler ya da duraklarıyla bir rota oluşturur.

Sadece fotoğraf ve müzik mi lazım? ChatGPT kullanmayacağınız eşya, görev ya da masraf bölümlerini kapatabilir, ama önce sana sorar.

ChatGPT tahmin etmek yerine eksikleri sorar (tarih, yer, kişi sayısı, müzik zevkin) ve sadece onayladıklarını ekler.

Her şey anında PurpleBee uygulamasında tüm grup için görünür. Uygulamada grubunu ayrıca ortak fotoğraf albümü, ortak müzik listesi, grup sohbeti, organizatörün onayladığı katılım istekleri, tekrarlanan etkinlikler, organizatör isterse eşya ve masraflar için fotoğraflı kanıt ve etkinlik sonrası değerlendirme bekliyor. Telefon numaraları katılımcılar arasında gizli kalır. ChatGPT senin adına çalışır ve sadece görebildiğin etkinliklere erişir. Oluşturup düzenleyebilir ama hiçbir şeyi silemez. PurpleBee sadece kimin kime borçlu olduğunu tutar, para transferi yapmaz.

PurpleBee'de yeni misin? purplebee.app adresinden e-postanla giriş yap.
